data.overview: Momcozy is an internet-first maternity and baby-care brand based in Kowloon, China (founded 2017, per Tracxn), which raised a private equity round in December 2023. In a promotional interview the brand states it holds medical device certifications (ISO13485, MDSAP, FDA 510K) for its breast pump, and its own product listings market a "100% natural" vegan, lanolin-free nipple cream. No independent safety, sustainability, or labour-ethics assessments of the brand appear in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Momcozy states its nipple cream is made from 100% natural, vegan, lanolin-free ingredients.

claims.claim: Momcozy claims to hold medical device certifications including ISO13485, MDSAP, and FDA 510K approval for its breast pump.
claims.quote: obtained relevant certifications, including the medical device ISO13485 certificate, MDSAP certificate, and the FDA 510K approval for our breast pump

papers.title: Exclusive Interview with Momcozy - The Beloved Maternity Brand Revolutionizing The Industry
papers.summary: An interview with Momcozy's North American Marketing Manager describes the brand, founded in 2018, as focused on maternity products and rapid, user-feedback-driven innovation. The company states it has established a medical device quality system with ISO13485, MDSAP, and FDA 510K certifications, plus global registrations across the US, Canada, Australia, EU and Middle East. The piece is a promotional interview rather than independent verification.

findings.text: Momcozy claims a robust medical device quality system with multiple international certifications for its breast pump.
findings.quote: obtained relevant certifications, including the medical device ISO13485 certificate, MDSAP certificate, and the FDA 510K approval for our breast pump

findings.text: Momcozy says it conducts over 200 one-on-one interviews with mothers and tests products with them before launch.
findings.quote: We conduct over 200 one-on-one interviews with mothers and invite them to be part of our development groups. Before any product launch, we ensure that it has been rigorously tested

papers.title: Momcozy - Company Profile, Funding & Competitors
papers.summary: Tracxn's company profile lists Momcozy as a late-stage, internet-first brand based in Kowloon, China, founded in 2017, offering multi-category products for moms and kids. It notes an undisclosed private equity round in December 2023 and roughly 154 employees, with competitors including Babycare and Grownsy.
